when a site does not have connectivity to a database the behavior of the product is controlled by an appsetting in the web config nbsp nbsp lt add key useinstallwizard value true gt when this value is set to true it invokes the install wizard this is the default behavior and it is set this way in order to make the web based installation process as simple and smooth as possible when it is set to false the application serves the standard error page there are situations that can arise in production environments where a previously installed site can temporarily lose connectivity to its database ie during a windows update of the database server or a network interruption in these cases if the useinstallwizard is set to true all visitors connecting to the site will be redirected to the install wizard page this is not acceptable behavior and in fact is a security vulnerability because the install wizard page discloses information about the internal configuration of the site to anonymous visitors during the installation process nbsp there is currently only nbsp one way for the system to know that nbsp a site nbsp was ever successfully installed previously ndash and that is by querying the database which means that if database connectivity is lost then the system has no idea if it was ever installed we need to include another method for the system to know it was installed previously ndash a method which is persistent and nbsp does not rely on external dependencies ie the database or non core file assets nbsp we need to introduce enhancements add another appsetting to web config which will indicate of the system was successfully installed previously rather than simply saving a boolean true false value it nbsp would be helpful to store more contextual information such as the version which was originally installed nbsp this value nbsp is already stored in the versions table in the database but it is more convenient to get access to it in the config file for diagnostic purposes this node will only be added to the config after a fully successful installation and will record the core version number of the package that was installed after a fully successful installation nbsp the system should change the value of useinstallwizard to false there is no valid reason why this value should ever be true after a successful installation and it would help mitigate undesirable behaviour if its value was set to false so basically the new logic would be if there is no database connectivity the system can then check if installversion lt gt nbsp ndash if true then the system knows that it was already successfully installed previously and should redirect to the error page ndash if false then it would execute the current logic checking the ldquo useinstallwizard rdquo appsetting etc hellip this would prevent the install wizard from ever being shown in a scenario where the system has already previously been successfully installed nbsp note that there is already an ldquo installationdate rdquo appsetting ndash but this serves a different purpose and cannot be utilized for this solution ie it is used during installation to determine if new machinekeys have been generated during install ndash which need to happen as the very first installation step prior to executing any database scripts on upgrade the system should set useinstallwizard to false so that existing sites will not continue to suffer from the current behavior the changes above should prevent the install wizard page from ever being displayed this will patch an additional issue which exists currently where a site loses database connectivity and visitors are presented with the intallwizard page where they can click continue and if the database has come back online it will proceed to re install the application over top of the existing application causing data integrity issues nbsp

a simple and non critical error in a frequently running task can easily flood the exception log this has two detrimental effects it is very hard for end users to determine errors in the system when this happens as the frequent error obscures any other errors the error log size can bring down the system i suggest we decouple the log itself from the moment the error occurred and log the latter in a separate table the exception logic would need to check for the specific error first this could be done by storing a hash of the error and using that as unique key in the error log table and then recording hash and time in the new table then in the error log ui give the user view options show errors sequentially as they occurred i e as it is now show the most occurring errors in descending order peter

when dotnetnuke installs a module with files being deployed into app code it adds a codesubdirectories node into the web config the purpose of this node is to allow class files written in different languages to be compiled into independent assemblies however it is not possible to add a subdirectory more than one level below the app code directory if you declare an entry more than one level below app code ie lt add directoryname test folder test child gt net will throw an immediate ysod run time error only subdirectories directly under the app code directory are allowed the standard convention for dynamic dotnetnuke modules is for the app code folder structure to match the desktopmodules folder structure where we support multiple levels of nested folders ie desktopmodules ownername modulename if you a deploy a dynamic module which was written using nested folders dotnetnuke will create an invalid codesubdirectories node ie lt add directoryname ownername modulename gt which results in an immediate unrecoverable crash of the application dotnetnuke does need to support dynamic modules written in both c and vb so the codesubdirectories logic is important however the installer logic needs to be modified so that it only declares one level of folder structure in the example above it would declare lt add directoryname ownername gt even though the code files are deployed to app code ownername modulename this instructs net that all subfolders under the app code ownername folder are written in the same language which will be the case of the time anyways if a developer tries to use mixed language code files in the subfolders the system will throw a run time error informing them of this problem dynamic modules using our recommended folder structure and packaged using the native extensions packager will not install properly into another dotnetnuke installation until this change is made

when trying to install third party modules or even do custom development in dotnetnuke there are syntax differences in what is supported in sql provisioning scripts on sql azure as opposed to standard sql server in total there are many syntax differences between the database platforms however there are a few syntax differences which are extremely common and can be dealt with in an automated manner when dotnetnuke executes sql script as part of installing an extensions or via the host sql module the system should look for the following common sql azure syntax pitfuls and intelligently fix them note that in fixing these issues it does not affect the ability of the script to execute on standard sql as well as these syntax items are not required remove on primary remove textimage on primary remove with so basically if we take the following sample sql script create table dbo mytable mytableid int identity not null field nvarchar not null constraint pk mytable primary key clustered mytableid asc with pad index off statistics norecompute off ignore dup key off allow row locks on allow page locks on on primary on primary we should convert it to create table dbo mytable mytableid int identity not null field nvarchar not null constraint pk mytable primary key clustered mytableid asc the sql script above will execute successfully on sql azure and standard sql server by fixing these common syntax issues we could likely expect a increase in the number of modules that can successfully install on sql azure without requiring any modifications on their part as part of this enhancement there is already code in the host sql modue which logs the actual script executed against the database in the eventlog if we modify the script to remove the syntax issues above we should write the converted script content to the eventlog to allow for simpler debugging measures

brief description of issue original issue posted on forum after upgrade a instance to dnn try to open the login page gets a popup square shows error code internal server error the request was rejected by the http filter contact the server administrator some investigated into the issue looks as it is a issue with verfy normailization i currently have no clue except for this hint i found this article and asked my hosting provider if they use isa or another apos something apos that does verify normalisation where the problem can be found in verify normalization select verify normalization blocks requests with urls containing escaped characters after normalization note web servers receive requests that are url encoded this means that certain characters may be replaced with a percent sign followed by a particular number for example corresponds to a space so a request for is the same as a request for dir my file htm normalization is the process of decoding url encoded requests because the can be url encoded an attacker can submit a carefully crafted request to a server that is basically double encoded if this occurs internet information services iis may accept a request that it would otherwise reject as not valid when you select verify normalization the http filter normalizes the url two times if the url after the first normalization is different from the url after the second normalization the filter rejects the request this prevents attacks that rely on double encoded requests note that while we recommend that you use the verify normalization function it may also block legitimate requests that contain a source confirmed with the hosting provider that on the firewall verify normalisation is active and block high bit characters is also active the issue happens also on a new install of dnn

summary leverage the abilities of client resource manager to refactor how css and js files are served and customized per portal problem description the current method for serving resource files relies on global files that only allow customization and control through changing the source files which affects all portals and creates upgrade issues and writing bloated skin container code to reset the core resetting is troublesome since some css properties can t be removed without artifacts that must be fixed with further code the process raises the bar for skills needed to successfully skin a site a few third party extensions allow skin designers to programmatically remove core file but this means carefully transferring parts of the core code lest some extension wouldn apos t look or work correctly upgrades to portals with these extensions wouldn t get any changes such as the addition of the jquery ui recently maintenance became a more laborious technical task important dnn creates a system that allows it to shift with prevalent internet standards and paradigms accordingly the ux patterns which are mostly generic and semantic would allow different ui libraries however the current method is rigidly coupled with jquery ui by designing the patterns around a more pluggable ui system the platform becomes more future ready the reliance on the default css file means it has grown in size and contains code that most users will never need further it is littered with declarations the bind the hands of designers a fact that is often discovered after much frustration it makes too many decisions for the designer thus reducing their ability to adopt emerging coding standards problem summary system requires bloated and redundant code for design customization legacy choices make skinning needlessly difficult system is rigidly tied to one ui library lighter methods of customization break the upgrade path a good deal of the code sent to the user isn apos t used system isn apos t flexible enough to support changes in the industry proposed solution the needs of the designers portal administrators and ultimately end users could be better addressed by a refactoring of the core css and js files the maturing of the client resource manager crm provides an opportunity to replace the current system with a far more robust and adaptable one central to the solution is to treat the portal root as equivalent to the website root from the crm point of view this would allow portal specific files to override the global version for full control over the final design footnote if the enhancement consideration below is added then portals css settings css file containing the variables would be all that is required to style the ui further as the crm can combining files the default css file should be broken up into as many functional components as possible this will aid in maintenance and debugging without affecting the end product maintenance is assisted as customizations are isolated from module and extension content for instance an override of default css need not touch the specific code for the tags module the tags module would be able to upgrade without interfering with the customizations to avoid backward compatibility issues the crm should pull resources from a new global css folder those that opt to not use the crm will use the current default css and avoid any issues if a css folder is present in the portal root the files in it will override the global counterparts a similar concept could work for the js folder the final piece to give designers full control would be a mechanism to remove assets from the skins with all of these in place a designer wouldn apos t have to override or patch the default styles nearly as much they could achieve unique designs without impacting other portals or upgrades enhancement consideration as the crm can use extensions the inclusion of a less or sass style parsing engine would allow easy restyling of all dnn parts these css parsers enable variables and other shortcuts which could become part of the code patterns for instance instead of a module developer setting the font size in pixels they would use the bodyfont variable of course that would mean a parser is required which may be too much of a commitment to a non wc concept

context multiple language packs installed and content localization activated brief description of issue logged on users in edit mode will not see the localized interface as per this description on the dotnetnuke wiki the problem is that we are using currentculture to localize the content and currentuiculture to localize the interface however there is no way to change the currentuiculture the problem here is that we tried to fix something that was only mildly broken and we fixed it with something that is very much broken there are use cases an admin wants to edit a different language on the page and uses the language selector on the page to change its language for his convenience the interface stays in the same language but the content of the module can now be edited in the other language the same admin wants to do an admin task and goes to any of the admin or host menus he wants to use the interface in a different language than the site is currently in he is not able to do that since there is no way to change the interface language the easy solution would be to make the currentculture and currentuiculture in sync again with the following effects if you want to edit content in a different language the language of the interface will also change you will now be able to view the interface in the right language so the proposal is to fix this in the short term by syncing currentculture and currentuiculture the long term solution enhancement would be this add an option for admins to either sync or not sync currentculture and currentuiculture by default both are synced i they are non synced the control panel will get an extra language selector that allows editors to select the interface language seperately

in skin injectcontrolpanel on or about line a control panel is loaded and attached to the control hierarchy for unauthorized users we expect that the visibility bit of the control will be cleared and no markup will be ultimately transmitted by this control however given that the preponderance of requests to a site will not result in a visible control panel the very high cost associated with attaching the control to the page hierarchy results in a severe performance penalty to remedy this issue i suggest allowing control panels to specify whether they would like to be attached to the page control hierarchy by introducing a property in controlpanelbase public virtual bool includeincontrolhierarchy get return true note that for compatibility reasons we default to true so that existing control panels will behave as they did previously similarly control panels can and should continue to perform additional authorization checks within their event handlers as has always been the case concrete control panels can modify the resulting bit based upon contextual authorization for example the property should be overridden in ribbonbar ascx cs to read public override bool includeincontrolhierarchy get return base includeincontrolhierarchy amp amp ispageadmin ismoduleadmin finally we adjust the injectcontrolpanel method in skin cs on or about line to consider this property controlpanel processing var objcontrolpanel controlutilities loadcontrol lt controlpanelbase gt this host controlpanel inject controlpanel control into skin if objcontrolpanel includeincontrolhierarchy return else if controlpanel null this is a very low impact change since it will not affect behavior for existing control panels however in my analysis i see a improvement in page throughput under stress this is a very big performance win for a very small change i suggest its immediate consideration

hi there we ve noticed that sporadically our sites will return a response for all pages except the home page we ve witnessed that the behavior always starts to be exhibited directly after the application pool is recycled once the results start occurring the only resolution is to recycle the application pool again which then clears the tab dictionary from cache so that it can be reloaded again i ve reviewed the code believe that the root cause of the issue is due to the fact that the code that builds the tab index portaldepths dictionary tabpaths dictionary is not thread safe i can see code in the method tabindexcontroller fetchtabdictionary is using shareddictionary classes to store the tab dictionaries however the code is not threadsafe when adding the dictionaries to the cache therefore when multiple threads are executing the fetchtabdictionary method it s possible for an empty dictionary to be added to the cache to resolve this issue the code needs to be updated so that only one thread can add the dictionaries at a time i have provided an updated version of the tabindexcontroller class with the fetchtabdictionary method modified as an attachment i ve also added another private helper method called portalexistsindex in the tabindexcontroller class that is used by the fetchtabdictionary to determine if the portal has already been added to the index this is an issue that seems to have been in dnn for some time here are a couple of links to others that have experienced similar behavior which seems like it might be due to the same issue

background the purgeeventlog stored procedure can perform badly when the eventlog gets over a certain size this is often encountered when an exception is being created frequently by the application in these cases the purge event log is unable to complete in addition to the slow performance of the query the structure of the purgeeventlog query means that it selectively deletes event log types based on the number of rows to keep as per the eventlogconfig table this leads to confusing diagnosis in many cases as supporting statements are deleted leaving an inaccurate timeline when looking back through time this change is to modify the purgeeventlog stored procedure so that it can be changed to a rolling date age based purge this should keep the log size relatively static over time depending on the log age chosen and whether there has been an increase or decrease in log activity with options appearing for off site log storage such as application insights and other solutions the need to keep an extensive log history is redundant and the log table is frequently the source of slow database performance database space failures and other issues current purgeeventlogcode requirements add a new host setting which specifies the maximum age for eventlogs to be kept this will be called eventlogkeepfordays for new installations and upgrades this value will be created and set to to keep existing behaviour in the purgeeventlog stored procedure the logic will change to note that this logic will bypass the current logic which checks the number of events to keep for each event type in favour of just keeping a set number of days of logs if the eventlogkeepfordays value is set the logic will switch to a simple date based delete the purpose of this requirement is to allow people who have set up more comprehensive log preservation to keep the on site logs small

throughout the dnn code there s a lot of incorrect uses of datetime now to store values into the database datetime now is the representation of the configured timezone on the server est cst etc we should always be storing datetime utcnow into the database so that values can be converted back to any local time as needed it makes dnn more portable when switching hosting providers in different geographical data centers because utc datetime is always the same regardless of timezone or daylight saving to be truly enterprise ready and secure dnn needs a consistent way to store date and time there is also a performance benefit to switch because datetime utcnow is many times faster than datetime now the net implementation of datetime now is actually taking datetime utcnow and converting it to local time of the server so it s doing a lot of unnecessary arithmetic

a moniker is a simple name provided for an objects that simplifies identifying specific object instances this concept was first used in microsoft object linking and embedding ole and the component object model com the dnn services framework was first introduced in dnn when creating web services with the service framework it is common to require callers to provide the moduleid and tabid as part of the web request header this requirement complicates the programming model since service endpoints become tied to their specific location in a website modules are able to easily retrieve the moduleid and tabid from the service framework as part of the initial module rendering however this mechanism is not available for remote callers where the ui rendering is not directly controlled by dnn in order to encapsulate this context data and to simplify the programming model for web services we should introduce the concept of a moniker the dnn service moniker will provide a mechanism for mapping a simple name to a specific module instance this moniker can then be passed to a web service in place of the moduleid tabid or any other context data specific to a module the moniker should be implemented as an additional system tabmodule setting by default the moniker will be composed of the page name the module definition friendly name and the tabmoduleid separated by when composing the default moniker all spaces should be replaced with dashes for example if the social groups module was on the community page with tabmoduleid of the default moniker would be community social groups the default moniker implementation provides a human friendly method to identify the page and module being addressed and also a unique element to differentiate between multiple modules on the same page the core platform should expose a service endpoint that allows an application to query for monikers related to a specific module type that the current user has permissions to view when calling service endpoints that need a specific module context the moniker will be included as part of the service call the service can then use the moniker to easily lookup any context for the module instance associated with the moniker developer notes the purpose of this step is to help the back end to create the dnn context for the web api request therefore it is not tied to any authentication mechanism like jwt basic forms etc injecting the moniker in the query part of the api request requires modifying all existing api s that need to use this moniker but is not feasible and requires making changes to existing core which we want to completely avoid what we need is a non invasive method one way in which this can be implemented is by adding a new vendor specific header in the request as an alternate way to using the tabid and moduleid that are in use today assume we are going to use x dnn moniker for this purpose an example of a full header would be x dnn moniker john s blog before being able to use this feature there is a need for an api that returns the various monikers associated with a specific module let s say in an evoq engage site if we need to find all the monikers that use the discussions module say discussions i e all tabs pages that have the discussions module in them we will send an api request that returns all of these monikers associated with discussion modules placed on various pages this call may return zero one or more monikers there must be a consideration for user rights in every data returned from the api no private data should be revealed to an un greetings all today i would like to highlight n issue we came across not long ago relating to posting web links into journal stream as we all know dnn has been great at scraping of web page contents anytime a link is posted but there exist the possibility of that link breaking your page long story short one of our clients included a link to rte ie article which to my surprise included a character description which would obviously overflow itemdata column in journal table to fix this problem i ve included a crude yet simple loop to truncate a description to fit character limit just before itemdata is set during save update procedures now it is important to note that itemdata is essentially json encoded string with the following properties url title description imageurl cacheability five properties that supposed to fit into characters is a tricky task in it self as there is no set limit to how long a url title description or imageurl can be but in my case it was clear that description was just out of proportions resulting in truncated itemdata value which was impossible to convert into back into object example of good itemdata after description has been truncated to fit competition is eleanor o reilly for her story stoppin the silence n ndolores walshe has been awarded nd prize for her story small yellow sun and kathryn burke s story irish gothic waiting for samhain library services journal journalcontrollerimpl cs that can cause this problem namely public void savejournalitem journalitem journalitem int tabid int moduleid public void updatejournalitem journalitem journalitem int tabid int moduleid each one has a line of code that sets what will be stored in itemdata column string journaldata journalitem itemdata tojson and to work around the problem i just added the following loop to reduce the length of description property until the whole thing fits character limit while journalitem itemdata tojson length journalitem itemdata description journalitem itemdata description substring journalitem itemdata description length string journaldata journalitem itemdata tojson each time while loops over itemdata property it removes characters from description until the condition is no longer valid at which point it should be safe to set the json string again just to reiterate on one important point because there is no hard length limit on itemdata properties in theory it can happen where say url property may take up the whole character limit but in practice no one uses urls that long however there are other properties the problem caused by scripts is that they block parallel downloads the http specification suggests that browsers download no more than two components in parallel per hostname if you serve your images from multiple hostnames you can get more than two downloads to occur in parallel while a script is downloading however the browser won t start any other downloads even on different hostnames in some situations it s not easy to move scripts to the bottom if for example the script uses document write to insert part of the page s content it can t be moved lower in the page there might also be scoping issues in many cases there are ways to workaround these situations an alternative suggestion that often comes up is to use deferred scripts the defer attribute indicates that the script does not contain document write and is a clue to browsers that they can continue rendering unfortunately firefox doesn t support the defer attribute in internet explorer the script may be deferred but not as much as desired if a script can be deferred it can also be moved to the bottom of the page that will make your web pages load faster

i have run into a very curious problem regarding cultures in the framework it concerns the use of the following method cultureinfo createspecificculture code there is another similar method however cultureinfo getcultureinfo code both return a cultureinfo object but there are subtle differences i had tests fail because on my machine the cultureinfo returned from the first method for en us used the date format d m yyyy i know you re thinking this is totally impossible but i changed the method to getcultureinfo and then the date format was m d yyyy again like it should be hmmm in more research i stumbled on this post from the answers but there is a somewhat surprising feature of the specific culture created if the culture identifier of the specific culture returned by this method matches the culture identifier of the current windows culture this method creates a cultureinfo object that uses the windows culture overrides the overrides include user settings for the properties of the datetimeformatinfo object returned by the datetimeformat property and the numberformatinfo object returned by the numberformat property what this means is that if the specific culture returned by createspecificculture matches the culture selected by the user in region and language control panel in windows then any user customizations to that culture is included in the cultureinfo returned e g the user may change the long date pattern or the decimal separator used in numbers another way to think about this is that when createspecificculture returns a culture that matches the name of currentculture it will actually return this culture including any user customizations as far as i can tell getcultureinfo does not have this property and will always return a unmodified cultureinfo suddenly i realized what had happened i have tuned my own pc to use a normal date pattern while still tuned to en us so it was overriding what was returned like wtf ok so now that i know why i am looking at what else could be impacted and it turns out getspecificculture is used throughout the framework is there any reason we should keep this method from the above it should be clear that this is not the right method to use we should be using getcultureinfo

customer has reported a bug that is present in the core dnn api which affects the module settings table when a character of size k is added to the column settingvalue from customer here is a screencast of the bug happening and being debugged in dnn s code we ve investigated this method updatemodulesettinginternal further and we have found what is the problem modulecontroller cs line the method uses a datareader in order to determine if a setting already exists in the modulesettings table and add or update the setting as it is appropriate this is a very bad idea datareaders keep their connection with the tables they use open while they themselves are not closed at least partially you can imagine that trying to update a table that is being kept open milliseconds before can eventually result in a deadlock that is what is happening in this case when the datareader reads the kb lorem ipsum that was already uploaded to modulesettings the table gets locked so when the code gets to dataprovider updatemodulesetting moduleid settingname settingvalue usercontroller instance getcurrentuserinfo userid and calls the sp that updates modulesettings the sp hangs when trying to update the table since the data we where modifying in the table was already there we commented in updatemodulesettinginternal all that had to do with the datareader and addmodulesetting this made the code work flawlessly every time instead of hanging every time possible solution for this my approach would be something like removing the datareader and instead checking for an existing row at stored procedure level the if exists statement has a better performance and has the perk of not locking the table after it has run then in case the row exists insert or update as needed of course this is just a suggestion but bear in mind that since the column settingvalue is nvarchar max large values are not beyond the scope of what could happen and we have proved it happened in one of our clients we just wanted to let you know of the problem and a possible fix let me know if i can be of any futher help with this issue please see attached ticket for more details on this issue

module controls have a controltype property which has allowable values of anonymous view edit admin host controltype tells the page compositing engine the type of permission that a user needs in order to load the control into a page controltype is currently managed as an enumeration and is stored as an integer value in the modulecontrols database table in order to support custom permission types within modules we should introduce a new controlpermission field in the modulecontrols table that is a string we will populate the value of this field based on the controltype using the name of the enumerated item rather than an integer we will remove control type from the user interface and allow a host user to enter a textbox for control permission in the extensions ui the default value should be view we will modify the core platform to utilize the controlpermission rather than the controltype ie it will be deprecated we will introduce a new node in the manifest for controlpermission which will be processed during installation and should also be included in the module packager for older modules that continue to ship using the controltype we will utilize the value and populate the controlpermission module creator will need to be modified to support more than view edit types anonymous admin and host do not refer to permission types they refer to roles and will continue to be handled the same way that they always have been view edit and any other values ie custom permissions will be interpreted as a permission type for the module and will utilize the platform permission system to determine if the control can be loaded if the value specified does not map to a permission type for the module the control should not be loaded

once discusses the issue at some length including debug logs that demonstrate it happening but in essence the call to runschedule is made every time a request is made for a page on a dnn site when the application pool is starting up it is currently possible for the schedulingprovider readyforpoll test to return true more than once if there are multiple new page requests hitting the server during the application pool startup this is a common occurrence on low demand dnn sites that dont utilize any sort of keep alive tool when those sites are visited by a crawler for example site is offline crawler targets the site potentially firing off a number page requests at all but the same time asp net sees first request and starts the process of bringing the dnn application into the application pool while this is happening other requests start arriving during this phase the dotnetnuke http application handler starts catching application beginrequest events one of the actions this triggers is the call to runschedule inside runschedule the systems tests to see if schedulingprovider readyforpoll is true which basically it is taking to mean the scheduler is not currently running if this is the case is then starts the process of creating a new schedulingprovider instance thread which ultimately brings the scheduler online but the problem is there is potentially a considerable lag between when schedulingprovider readyforpoll is tested and found to be true and when the system has got the scheduler thread running and schedulingprovider readyforpoll is eventually put into a start that allows it to return a value of false if there are multiple httprequest arriving at the server during this phase see the forum thread for example from debug log test in the time between when the first request tests readyforpoll other requests can also have tested readyforpoll and all get to see the result of the test as true at which stage they each of those page requests all try to start triggering the process of starting up a schedulerprovider background worker thread on my test system i was easily able to trigger or separate instances of the schedulerprovider on a regular basis simply by manually starting browser pages at the same time on a system being hit by a search crawler that often fire off or more requests at once it would not be unlikely for that to be the case and ironically may be the cause of a number of different system event log errors and forced application pool restarts that clients have reported in the past that seem to always relate to sites being hit be web crawlers to fix the issue i am suggesting that a lock statement on a static local object should be added this will prevent more than one instance of the schedulerprivider ever being created if this issue fix has also been reported by me on the dnn forum post am by user i ran into a high cpu problem on our production server last week dnn version the problem did not manifest itself on our single core test environment nor in our development environments there also seemed to be no relation between any particular request and the probability of the problem occurring i made dumps using debugdiag and the bit version of taskmanager analyses of the dumps with windbg showed all of the runaway threads busy with an insert call on a generic dictionary in the usercontroller getcacheduser method this method indeed gets a dictionary from the cache and sets a value on it the dictionary is a common generic dictionary not thread safe however the object is shared among threads through the cache and thus a thread safe dictionary should be used i have fixed this by changing line in method usercontroller getuserlookupdictionary so that the cbo getcachedobject overload with the saveindictionary parameter is used having set the saveindictionary parameter to true i have attached the fixed version of usercontroller cs see lines this bug probably also affects all versions and earlier versions because the offending methods have not been changed so far the high cpu problem has not returned in the past hours before the fix the problem would manifest itself one or more times per hour the fix does not seam to have had any adverse effects on performance or otherwise

amazon elastic load balancing ssl offloading uses headers that also contain data cathal did a bit of research on this and reported this the clearest step by step guide so it would appear that elb supports ssl offloading obviously the header value has to be configured in dotnetnuke as well that took a bit more searching and it seems that amazon use header see the problem here is that both header values always seem to contain data i e x forwarded proto will contain http or https and x forwarded port will contain or this goes contrary to the behavior or basically every other network device where the existence of the header is sufficient to say that it was forwarded i e most simply add x forwared proto or x forwarded with no data and those such as f that allow custom headers don t allow variant values our ssl offloaded solution checks for the existence of a header and does not evaluate it s value i believe this is why you can t get it working i see that magento has a similar issue which suggests they used the same approach that article has a hack where they re setting an additional header in apache based on the protocol and in theory we could do the same or add code to a page to do the same but i would recommend not using such a hack as such elb would not be supported by our ssl offloading solution currently if we want to support this we will need to enhance it to check for the existence of the header variable and optionally check for a value stored in that header variable furthermore he comments if we want to support elb and potentially any others that use this non standard scheme we will have to enhance it i would estimate around hrs effort hrs dev hrs qa hr documentation update

some system resources have hierarchical dependencies on one another and therefore are governed by rules of inheritance module view permissions can be inherited from page permissions but not implicitly rather there is an inherit view permissions from page checkbox which is available at the module level this checkbox is selected by default and it allows all modules to be made visible to visitors who are allowed to view the page module edit permissions can be inherited from page permissions a user that is granted full control edit or add content permissions at the page level automatically inherits full control edit at the module level unless permissions have been explicitly denied at the module level module permissions that have been explicitly denied will override page permissions

in the event that a user role has been granted full control edit rights for a page it overrides all other individual permission settings for that user role and modifying individual permissions will set full control edit to not specified in the event that a user role has been denied full control edit rights for a page it overrides all other individual permission settings for that user role and modifying individual permissions will set full control edit to not specified
in the event that a user is part of multiple roles that have permission specifications for the same resource deny will always override grant unless the user is an administrator

developers who want to build extensions for the dotnetnuke platform must first be familiar with the basic cms user experience for creating pages module instances and content with this in mind creating a new custom module should be no more difficult than it is to add an existing module to a page leveraging the standard user experience we will create a new development module category in the add module menu in the control panel a new module creator module will be available in this category this module is only relevant to host users the should make the option very discoverable and accessible for developers ie they do not have to navigate the various administrative menus addnewdevelopmentmodule png this module creator module can be added to any page just like a normal dotnetnuke module it exposes a number of basic options which a developer will need to provide in order to create a custom module owner name dotnetnuke requires a unique top level namespace to ensure uniqueness the owner name could be an organization name brand name developer s name etc the system will save the value provided as a host setting so that it can be used as a default for any modules created in the future module name a short name to identify the purpose of the module description optional a description of the module language c or vb the default is c changing the selection reloads the list of templates template a list of templates loaded dynamically based on the language selected it will only display templates of type module there are different dynamic module models which can be utilized based on preference inline script user control and razor the default will be module user control when a user selects a template it will load and display an associated readme txt file if one exists the readme txt file can contain a description of the template files but it can also include code samples which could be cut and pasted into the module control to add additional functionality control name modules can contain multiple controls this option allows the user to specify the name of the file created the default will be view modulecreatorform png when the developer presses the create module button it will register the module in the database create a module category for the owner and associate it to the module and update the moduledefid of the module instance with the moduledefid of the newly registered module the end result is that the module creator module will be replaced on the page with the new module created at this point the module is fully usable within the environment and the developer can browse to the page where it is located using the standard website navigation
